posts.community: Vasa Denticity aka Dentalkart - The Indian Amazon of Dental supplies ?!
posts.text: The real moat is never the platform itself. It’s the time with large share of customers on that platform you have. That gives you extremely important data on behaviour, needs, demands, seasonality etc of the customers which any new player will take years recreating. That imo gives you that advantage to supply what is needed and not keep random assortment. That is the real moat. Another thing is relationships and knowledge base on supply side. They are not only selling commodity stuff. Devices and specialised/branded pharma takes lots of effort in procurement, inventory management, and even dig…
